model: Annual closed three-stage plant-population projection n(t+1)=L*n(t)with COLUMN stage counts. Every unspecified matrix entry is zero. Source fecundities are already effective per-census entries; do not multiply them again by survival. The five source parameters vary independently for LOCALsensitivity, and the model remains in its positive-parameter neighborhood.
target: Report the asymptotic annual population multiplier, the normalized positive right-eigenvector adult fraction, and each source parameter elasticity dlog(lambda)/dlog(parameter). Select ALL largest elasticities within1e-9, without confusing right-eigenvector stage abundance with left-eigenvector reproductive value or largest raw parameter.
scope: This is a conditional linear-model sensitivity assessment, not a finite intervention prediction, actual field-management recommendation or evidence of density-independent growth forever. Stage counts and census conventions are held fixed.

provenance.data_origin: Explicit small controlled benchmark models, sequences and traits; no empirical evolutionary, functional or conservation-outcome claim.
